about_short_description.short_description: DataSnipper is a financial audit company that provides an AI-powered intelligent automation platform in Excel.

product.name: DataSnipper Intelligent Automation Platform
product.description: An AI-powered audit and finance platform integrated with Excel that automates testing, document review, data extraction, evidence tracing, and other repetitive procedures.

product.name: External Audit Solutions
product.description: Audit automation tools for tests of detail, tests of control, walkthrough documentation, financial statement procedures, and Excel-based audit reporting.

product.name: Internal Audit Solutions
product.description: Automation tools for internal controls testing, SOX compliance work, IT controls testing, and evaluation of control effectiveness using supporting evidence.

product.name: Financial Control Solutions
product.description: Finance control automation for invoice processing, contract review, financial document reconciliation, and financial statement validation.

product.name: Tax Solutions
product.description: Tax workflow automation for inspecting tax documents, extracting data from tax forms and invoices, and reviewing transfer pricing documentation.

product.name: Government Audit Solutions
product.description: Audit automation for grant audits, controls testing, tests of detail, centralized grant document reviews, and Excel-based government audit reporting.
